command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-code.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-code stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R1's Fix contradicts design.md D5 and its Fix risk does not say so. D5 says useVisibleStripRows 'returns the candidate rows', 'calls `setState` only when `firstRow` or `lastRow` changed (NFR-P1)', and 'GridView.tsx calls the hook once and passes the candidates to both MeetingHandleSliders in place of rowCount'. The Fix has the hook work out and publish the handle rows instead, 'pass each slider its row number in place of candidateRows', and freezes the hook whenever no meeting range is set. The Fix must either revise D5 and the grid-view delta-spec scenario 'Scrolling re-places the handles cheaply' (spec.md:59-63) through /opsx:update in the same fix, or use a fix that keeps D5's wiring (e.g. MeetingHandleSlider skips re-rendering when its getMeetingHandleRow row is unchanged).

R1's Fix adds the step 'When a scroll changes the candidate rows but not the handle rows / Then no meeting handle is rendered again' to grid_view_meeting_handle_reach_unit.feature but does not add it to the matching scenario of the grid-view delta spec, which only says 'a scroll that leaves the candidate rows unchanged re-renders no meeting handle'. The Gherkin and the spec would drift apart; the Fix should name the spec and tasks.md updates as well.
